data.name: TTM
data.detailed_description:
TTM is a local multiplayer game for 1–4 players, where two teams clash in fast-paced tactical battles.

🎮 Pick Your Role

Each team controls a Tank and a Fighter — two completely different playstyles that must work together to win.

🪖 Tank A slow but powerful ground unit. Blast enemies with your cannon, deploy a fuel hose to drain the opponent Fighter's fuel, and activate the side Light to repel attackers.

✈️ Fighter A nimble aircraft that flies freely across the entire arena. Ram enemy tiles to destroy them, paralyze opponents with ShockWaves, and use the Sonar to buff your friendly Tank or destroy enemy projectiles from anywhere on the map.

🧱 How to Win

Each team owns 11 tiles on their side of the arena. Destroy 8 of the opponent's tiles — or eliminate their Tank — and victory is yours.

⚡ Dynamic Events

Just when you think you have the upper hand, the arena strikes back. Random mid-match events shake up the battlefield:

  • Laser — a deadly beam sweeps the center line. Redirect it by shooting the switch!

  • Firewall — walls of flame erupt from the dividing line

  • Octopus — a giant octopus grabs Fighters and hurls them across the arena, straight into their own tiles

🏆 Power-Up System

Destroy enemy tiles to earn permanent upgrades mid-match:

  • Tank: extra bouncing shots, shields, faster hose, extended Side Light

  • Fighter: wider ShockWaves, faster Sonar, Chain Lightning, absorbing enemy projectiles boosts your speed

🕹️ Features

  • Local multiplayer — 1 to 4 players on one machine

  • Gamepad support — Xbox, PlayStation and more

  • Keyboard — fully customizable controls per player

  • Mixed input — each player can use a different device

  • AI opponents — play with bots when you're short on players

  • Random events — every match feels different

  • Fast matches — a typical game lasts 3–8 minutes

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 240 — OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 570 / Intel UHD 630
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
